seo.h1: Online Stamp & Seam Seal for Contracts
seo.sub: PDF / Word / Excel / images · Convert locally · Zero uploads
seo.guide_title: What is a seam seal? Can I stamp Word, Excel, or photos?
seo.guide_text: A cross-page stamp (seam seal) is applied across the outer edges of multi-page contracts, tenders, and official forms. Splitting one seal across pages prevents tampering or page swaps. This tool converts Word, Excel, and images to PDF in your browser, then splits and places the seal with live control over size, position, and opacity.

faqs.q: Is it safe to use this tool for confidential PDF contracts? Will files be uploaded?
faqs.a: It is 100% safe and confidential. This tool operates entirely on client-side WebAssembly and HTML5 Canvas technology. All PDF processing and seal splitting occur inside your browser memory. No files are ever sent to any remote server.

faqs.q: How can I adjust the stamp position and size across multi-page PDFs?
faqs.a: After uploading your file and stamp image, select 'Ride-Seam' mode. Use the config panel to customize stamp size (mm), vertical position (%), opacity, and edge alignment with real-time interactive preview.

faqs.q: Can I upload Word, Excel, or phone photos of a contract?
faqs.a: Yes. The stamp tool accepts PDF, Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx / CSV), and common image formats. Files are converted to PDF inside your browser before preview and stamping. Legacy .doc / .xls should be saved as .docx / .xlsx first.

faqs.q: What happens if my PDF document has dozens of pages?
faqs.a: Our tool features an intelligent auto-grouping mechanism. When page counts exceed the maximum split limit (e.g. 20 pages), the system divides the stamp into optimal sub-groups so every split segment remains crisp and clear.

faqs.q: What stamp image formats are supported? How do I handle white backgrounds?
faqs.a: We support PNG (transparent) and JPG images. If using a JPG stamp with a white background, enable 'Auto White Removal' and 'Multiply Blend Mode'. The tool will automatically strip the white fill and overlay ink naturally over text.
